chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi 'Umayr from Abu Ayyub al-Kazzaz from Salamah ibn Muhraz, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a man who had intercourse with his wife before performing the Tawaf al-Nisa', and he said, 'There is no penalty upon him.' I went out to our companions and informed them, and they said, 'Beware, this is al-Muyassir; he asked him about the same thing you asked, and he said to him, 'Upon you is a camel (badanah).'

He said: So I entered upon him and said, 'May I be your ransom, I informed our companions of what you informed me, and they said, 'Beware, this is al-Muyassir; he asked him about the same thing you asked, and he said to him, 'Upon you is a camel.' So he said to him, 'Indeed, that had reached him, so has it reached you?' I said, 'No.' He said, 'There is no penalty upon you.'

key_terms.بَدَنَةٌ: A camel, used as a specific form of expiation (kaffarah) in Islamic law
key_terms.طَوَافُ اَلنِّسَاءِ: Tawaf al-Nisa', the final circumambulation of the Kaaba performed to complete Hajj
key_terms.قَدْ بَلَغَهُ: It had reached him, implying the knowledge or ruling was applicable to him
key_terms.لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ: There is no penalty upon him, indicating exemption from expiation
key_terms.مُيَسِّرٌ: Al-Muyassir, a narrator or title referring to a specific individual in the chain of transmission

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for a pilgrim who has intercourse with his wife before Tawaf al-Nisa'?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* illustrates the Shia jurisprudential principle of *khata'* (error) versus *'amdan* (deliberation) in the context of Hajj penalties. Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) distinguishes between a pilgrim who is unaware of the ruling and one who is informed, showing that the penalty of *badanah* (a camel) applies specifically when the prohibition is known to the individual. This highlights the importance of *'ilam* (notification) in determining legal liability for breaking Hajj conditions.
